headline: Xiaomi edges past DeepSeek; InclusionAI debuts top 15
summary: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 holds rank 1 with 17.8% share after a quiet day, while DeepSeek's v4-flash sits at 2 with 11.8%—both providers gaining ground over the month. InclusionAI's ling-3.0-flash enters at rank 14 with 1.5% share, joining three other new models in the top 51.
highlights: Xiaomi 18.8% provider share (+3.4% in 7 days, +8.9% in 30 days)
DeepSeek 17.7% provider share (+4.2% in 7 days, +1.7% in 30 days)
InclusionAI debuts at rank 14 with 1.5% token share
Anthropic slides to 7.5% provider share (−5.0% in 7 days, −8.7% in 30 days)
NVIDIA up to 5.4% provider share (+3.2% in 30 days)
